item.title: Tinubu To NEC: Move Beyond Dialogue, Deliver Results For Nigerians
item.description: Tinubu has urged NEC to move beyond dialogue to action on reforms.

item.title: Ohuabunwa To FG: Declare Cancer Emergency In Nigeria
item.description: Senator Mao Ohuabunwa, has urged the federal government to consider declaring a national emergency on the fight against cancer.

item.title: Arogundade: Senate Must Adopt House Version To Secure Full Electronic Transmission Of Election Results
item.description: Executive Director of International Press Centre, Arogundade, says legal backing for electronic transmission protects transparency, verification. credibility in 2027 elections

item.title: Senate Again Rejects Mandatory Real-Time E-Transmission, Leaves At INEC Discretion
item.description: The Senate has failed to enshrine real-time, mandatory electronic transmission of election results into Nigeria’s electoral law.

item.title: NRS Targets N40.7trn Revenue In 2026, Posts 12% Above-Target Collection
item.description: NRS has set N40.71trn 2026 target, 44% above 2025 goal, after exceeding last year’s revenue by 12%.

item.title: Nigeria To Begin Sale Of State Owned Assets In 2026, Wale Edun Confirms
item.description: Finance minister Wale Edun says government will identify assets and timelines for sale as Nigeria courts private investors and partnerships.

item.title: Sawyerr: NELFUND Ensures No Eligible Student Denied Exams Despite Verification Delays
item.description: NELFUND's Akintunde Sawyerr says over one million beneficiaries nationwide will access education loans, with institutions cooperating to protect students’ rights.

item.title: SEC Urges Civil Servants To Leverage Capital Market For Wealth Creation
item.description: SEC has urged civil servants to tap into capital market opportunities to build wealth, enhance retirement security and avoid Ponzi schemes.

item.title: NSITF Dismisses Allegations Of Fund Misappropriation Against MD Falaye
item.description: NSITF has denied claims of financial impropriety against its Managing Director, Oluwaseun Faleye, insisting all funds remain secure.

item.title: Dangote, Obasanjo Visit Burundi To Explore Investment Opportunities
item.description: Dangote, accompanied by Obasanjo, met Burundi’s president to explore investments in minerals, energy, agriculture, cement and infrastructure.
